summary: 10.0.41.04 Security Session Lockdown, Modular ViewLoader Architecture & Universal Refresh Layout Stability
highlights: 1. Strict Session Authentication Lockdown: Eliminated unauthenticated fallback to admin in AuthService and app.js. Added 8-hour session TTL with backend /api/auth/me token validation.

2. Modular ViewLoader Architecture (1 Screen = 1 Dedicated .html File): Implemented ViewLoader service to dynamically load dedicated view templates on demand with caching, matching Desktop FXML loader parity.
3. Universal Refresh Layout Stability: Pre-rendered native 58px compact ribbon KPI cards on Master Data screen, eliminating frame-0 visual deformation and squishing.
4. Master Data Categories Rail Width Locking: Strictly enforced 345px fixed geometry for .master-categories-rail with CSS !important rules and skeleton item placeholders.
5. Skeleton Loading System: Replaced collapsing spinner text with shimmer skeleton rows in MasterDataController for category rail and lookup tables.
6. Non-Destructive KPI Enhancement: Updated KpiCardEnhancer to preserve pre-rendered compact-kpi-card structure, preventing innerHTML destruction on page boot.
7. Immediate Synchronous Clock Parsing: Initialized clock display immediately after header tag in index.html to prevent blank clock on refresh.
